description: This stacked bar chart illustrates "Targets (conceptualized or operationalized) over time." The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled "Year," presenting chronological years from 2012 to 2022 in ascending order with vertically rotated text. The vertical value axis features a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 0.2, accompanied by dashed horizontal gridlines across the plot area. The chart utilizes 100% stacked vertical bars to show the proportional distribution of different target quantities for each year. According to the "Targets" legend, the stacked components are color-coded as follows: "0" in blue, "1" in orange, "2-4" in green, "5-7" in red, and "8+" in purple. When present, the segments are consistently stacked from bottom to top in the order of blue, orange, green, red, and purple. The bar compositions vary significantly across the timeframe; for instance, the 2012 bar is composed entirely of a single green "2-4" segment spanning the full 1.0 value, while the 2013 bar consists solely of the blue "0" segment at 1.0. In contrast, the 2019 bar contains all five legend segments, starting with blue at approximately 0.2, orange at 0.2, green at 0.22, red at a maximum thickness of 0.34, and a small purple segment at the top representing roughly 0.04. Notably, the bar for the final year, 2022, is visually differentiated from the rest of the chart, as its segments are rendered in lighter, muted pastel shades of the standard blue, orange, green, and red colors.
